category_title: Students who exhibit initial fear and avoidance but transition to engagement through curiosity and hands-on success
scenario_title: Nature walk and off-path bug observation
minimal_context: The student is participating in a group nature walk in the woods to look for bugs and observe worms under an overturned log.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, we are going into the woods now for our nature walk to look for bugs.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Zips up her sweatshirt and ties her hood on tight) I am very scared about going into the woods. I don't like bugs.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep walking with the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Holds her field guide over her head) This isn't something that I want to do. I'm scared.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone step off the path over here. There are a lot of worms under this overturned log to look at.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Refuses to walk toward the overturned logs) Why does it have to be over there?
